_the_rule: E12 Ruling 9d: an element whose surface a view cannot see is dropped from that view's stem - a term present in a view's prompt is an instruction to paint it, and the text wins against the control (the W3 beard mechanism, measured). Split deviation measured and ruled at E12 Ruling 10i.
_assertions: Each stem asserted an ordered SUBSEQUENCE of the entry's term list; each view with no drops asserted BYTE-EQUAL to the entry. Both enforced in the builder with no skip flag; a failure writes no file.
_supersedes: E12-pair-6 (6068ba4). ONE COMPOUND TERM SPLIT INTO TWO (E12 Ruling 18c, on the handoff-9 partial): 'moss-green wing arms and finger struts' becomes 'moss-green wing arms' + 'moss-green wing finger struts', each its own noun phrase, at indices 2 and 3. Nothing else moved - no other term substituted, removed or reordered, and the drop map is byte-identical - so every per-view term count is exactly one greater than v6 and the full-string view set is unchanged. ONLY VIEW 4 regenerates under v7 (Ruling 18c): view 0's v6 twin STANDS, fixed in full at -66.4%, and regenerating a good landing for stem uniformity is churn.
_wing_term_split: E12 Ruling 18c. v6 named the wing skeleton with ONE compound phrase and the result split by view: on view 0 the whole structure took green (-66.4% ivory, every strut); on view 4 the leading-edge ARMS took green and the FINGER STRUTS stayed cream (-29.3%) - on the view that presents the wings as the archetypal bat skeleton, with two bone-ivory terms still in its stem. Read: the compound phrase's HEAD NOUN bound and its SECOND CONJUNCT under-bound, exactly where the anatomy prior pushes hardest. The fix is grammatical, not lexical - each conjunct becomes its own noun phrase, which is E08 Amendment 13's form (head noun + minimal modifier lands; stacked compound modifiers drop) applied to a conjunction rather than to a modifier stack.
_scope: ONLY view 4 regenerates under v7. View 0's v6 twin stands. Views 1/2/3B/5/6/7 stand as generated under v5, and views 1 and 5 are pixel-identical to the ACCEPTED pair - regenerating them would break that identity for no defect. Stem-version provenance rides each twin's sidecar.

Net: mouth family off {3,4,5}, horn family off {3,5}. UNCHANGED at v7 - both wing terms are in neither family and ride every view, because wings are visible from all eight yaws.
_palette_correction: E12 Ruling 12e, carried forward unchanged: D2 pale olive-tan, D6/D7 charcoal. 'bone' appears twice and 'ivory' three times, all at the head.
